observations.action_context: exact constrained-action input token IDs copied before action generation; no decoded reconstruction
observations.event_order: copy inputs before generate; uncertainty observed before env.step; no post-action feature inputs
observations.state_type_definition: q06-available-actions-v1: has_search_bar => search; else clickables contain buy now or start with description/features => product; else results
observations.token_counts: exact independently tokenized prompt and rendered history, add_special_tokens=False

predictive_protocol.candidate: simultaneous lower bound > 0.02 and trajectory directions agree
predictive_protocol.familywise: Holm p and Bonferroni percentile simultaneous 95% CI
predictive_protocol.prospective_confirmation: requires separate frozen predictor before fresh independent trajectory labels; S2 alone does not satisfy it

s3_bank.activation: snapshot capture covered by these S2 cells; cross-checkpoint bank scoring requires its exact resource contract before model calls
s3_bank.same_input_scoring: exact retained observation/prompt/history/action schema/action context tokens, no environment reset or generation to manufacture history
s3_bank.selection: outcome-blind SHA256(q06-bank-v1|cell_id|task_identity|step) ascending within strata; no refill from outcome columns; short stratum remains PARTIAL
